notes.title: V0.0.6
notes.content:
Balance Adjustments:
Legions:

Elf Priest
Mana Cap: 120 → 80
Healing Totem's healing reduced by 1/3

Interface Optimization:
Removed the Tiny Commander model, replaced with avatar display.
Updated the position of the acquired enhancements UI.
Added icons for all synergies, and used brass, silver, and gold colors to distinguish synergy levels.
Optimized the display of the enhancement details interface.
Updated unit attribute icons.
Updated equipment icons.

New Features:
Added a damage information panel during battles.
Support for viewing the previous round's battle data during the deployment phase.
Added prompts for level, gold, wins, and health.
Added unit attribute function prompts.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed the incorrect text display for the Undead synergy.

notes.title: v0.0.5 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Balance Adjustments:

Equipment:

Assassin's Blade Adjustment
Side attacks now also trigger the damage boost effect.
Attack speed increased by 20%.
Damage increased by 40% when attacking enemies from the back or side.

Cursed Sword Nerf
Removed the +50% attack speed bonus.

Cursed Staff Nerf
Spell power reduced from 200 to 150.

Enhancements:
Frenzy Virus Buff
Health loss per second reduced from 3% to 2%.


Enhancement Appearance Conditions:
1."All IN" will not appear in the first enhancement round.
2."Stable Finance" and "Defeat Insurance" will only appear in the first two enhancement rounds.
3."Refresh Expert," "Regular Deposit," and "Money Power" will only appear in the first three rounds.


Other Changes:
1.Shop discounts removed.
2.Coins gained per round increased by 2.
3.Maximum player level increased from 7 to 8.


Bug Fixes:
1.Fixed the bug where free refresh counts were not being saved correctly.

notes.title: v0.0.4 Update description
notes.content:
Balance Adjustments:
Bond Changes:
Undead Adjustments:

When an enemy unit dies, there is a chance for an undead unit to spawn in that position after 3 seconds.
(3) 30% chance to summon a Level 1 Undead Guard
(5) 35% chance to summon a Level 2 Undead Guard, with a 10% chance to summon a Level 2 Death Knight
(8) 45% chance to summon a Level 3 Undead Guard, with a 30% chance to summon a Level 3 Death Knight
Cavalry Adjustments:

At the start of the battle, all units gain increased damage and movement speed for 8 seconds. [Cavalry] charges forward, dealing damage and stunning collided units. If the charge kills the target, the charge continues.
(2) 10% damage increase, 10% movement speed increase, charge deals 200% attack damage, 2-second stun
(4) 15% damage increase, 15% movement speed increase, charge deals 300% attack damage, 2.5-second stun
(6) 20% damage increase, 20% movement speed increase, charge deals 450% attack damage, 3-second stun
New Warrior Effect:

[Warriors] can execute low-health units, recovering health upon execution.
(6) Execute targets below 30% health, recover 45% of lost health
Assassin Nerf:

At the start of the battle, [Assassins] enter stealth and leap to the last enemy position in the same column after 1 second, gaining increased critical damage and critical strike chance, as well as 150% movement speed for 5 seconds. Killing an enemy unit refreshes this effect and re-enters stealth.
(1) Critical damage bonus 50% → 40%
(3) Critical damage bonus 80% → 65%
(5) Critical damage bonus 130% → 100%
Other Changes:

Maximum level increased from 6 to 7
First four refresh costs increased from 1 to 2 (supplement to changes in v0.02)
Bug Fixes:

Attempted to fix a crash issue
Fixed a bug where Royal Sniper's rarity was displayed incorrectly in the shop

Synergy Changes:

(8) Summons a LV3 undead unit every 4 seconds → every 2 seconds
Guardian Nerfs:

notes.title: v0.02 Update
notes.content:
Thank you very much to all the players who participated in the playtest! Based on your feedback, we have made some optimizations and fixed some bugs in the version.

Here are the update details for v0.02:

Optimizations:

Optimized the selection detection of units on the chessboard, making it easier to select units.
The details panel of synergies now shows which units are present in these synergies.
A prompt box will now appear if a piece purchased from the shop can be directly combined.
Changed the method of summoning units for the Undead synergy from accumulating energy by killing targets to summoning based on time.
Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue with the incorrect color of the 3-star piece indicator.
Fixed the incorrect text description for the Assassin synergy.
Fixed a bug where placing equipment when a unit's equipment slots were full would cause the equipment to disappear.
